$comment: Geometry read out of Creator Store models so a game can rebuild them from primitives, with no InsertService and no binary in the repository. Meshed parts rebuild as a Part carrying a SpecialMesh, because MeshPart.MeshId cannot be written at runtime -- which means no SurfaceAppearance and box collision. Everything is relative to the model's pivot and is anchored on rebuild.
